title: Nocturne Edge: token router and interaction pulse preservation for dark-brand console themes
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: Brand-themed dark modes are increasingly producing visual regressions in high-density UI surfaces (tables, small buttons, micro-charts). Current token inheritance causes brand accents to 'bleed' into data visuals (gridlines, sparklines) and interactive pulses to lose contrast on low-luminance surfaces. Goal: define a token routing layer (Nocturne Edge) that deterministically maps brand tokens to dark-safe variants and exposes a compact set of component override hooks so charts, tables, buttons, and icons preserve legibility and interaction affordances without requiring per-brand ad-hoc patches.
acceptance_criteria: Design token router spec published that defines precedence and mapping rules (brand -> nocturne adjustments -> component overrides -> fallback)
Prototype tokens implemented as CSS variables and exported to design tokens JSON; dev team can apply router to a sample dashboard page
Edge cases covered: micro-button states (press/hover/focus), table zebra stripes at 12% contrast delta, chart gridlines remain >= 3:1 contrast against series area under common brand palettes
Accessibility sign-off from A11y review with test prompt set and screenshots showing all critical components passing contrast checks
Migration guide for applying the router to existing brand themes with minimal manual overrides
work_items: Create token router design doc and decision log
Build token mapping table for top 10 customer brand palettes
Prototype CSS variable implementation for console header, tables, and charts
Coordinate with runtime/design tokens export pipeline (Design Tokens team)
Run automated contrast regression tests and capture screenshots
Create developer migration guide and example PR
